title: Mahjongg for Independent Players
description: 1:00 PM – 3:00 PM · Looking to enjoy an afternoon of friendly games of mah-jongg for independent players? Join us at the Library every Wednesday from 1-3pm. Bring your 2026 card if you have one, although we have plenty of loaners if you don't! We'll have tables, cloths, chairs, and sets.   NOTE: This is not a mah-jongg lesson. A general knowledge of the game is necessary to join. Please register in advance if you'd like to join so we can make sure we have enough tables set up for everyone!

title: Kids Cook
description: 3:30 PM – 4:30 PM · Join us every Wednesday for a fun and tasty adventure in the kitchen! Learn how to make delicious and creative snacks using safe cooking tools alongside other young chefs. Free and open to kids ages 5-12.  Ünete a nosotros todos los miércoles para una divertida y sabrosa aventura en la cocina. Aprende a hacer bocadillos deliciosos y creativos usando herramientas de cocina seguras junto a otros jóvenes chefs. Gratis y abierto para niños de 5 a 12 años.

title: Parenting Workshop
description: 5:00 PM – 6:30 PM · Join us for a fun and informative family workshop focused on helping your child build healthy habits! Guest speakers from Skippy Dental and Amy Erickson from San Miguel Ouray Public Health will share helpful tips on children's dental health and nutrition. Families will also receive handouts with healthy lunch and snack ideas to take home and try with their little ones. Come learn, connect, and discover simple ways to support your child's health and well-being! FREE DINNER AND CHILDCARE / CENA Y CUIDADO DE NIÑOS GRATIS ¡Únanse a nosotros en un taller familiar, divertido e informativo, diseñado para ayudar a sus hijos a desarrollar hábitos saludables! Contaremos con la participación de representantes de Skippy Dental y de Amy Erickson, del Departamento de Salud Pública de San Miguel-Ouray, compartirán consejos útiles sobre la salud dental y la nutrición infantil. …
